wire.t: Sunday's in. Picken Weiners 208.12, Hanging with Hernandez 66.66 with Derrick Henry still to play Monday night. That's a 141.46-point margin, bigger than the 137.60 season record, and it only holds if Henry scores zero.

I Believe in Love beat Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 155.82 to 141.22. Neither team has anyone left. Emmett Johnson of the Chiefs scored 35.10 at FLEX for Buccaneer51 the week ChuckJ10's Kenneth Walker III sat out.
Omar Cooper Jr. was listed questionable to return with an ankle injury against the Bills and then ruled out. He started at FLEX for ChuckJ10 and finished with 0.00. That wasn't a lineup mistake.

Christian McCaffrey became the all-time leader in receiving touchdowns by a running back. He scored 49.30 for TotesMagoat, the top starter score of the week, and Lemon Squeezy beat Hurts So Good 173.72 to 156.98.

Marco_Polo started the week with both RB slots empty and finished it the same way. Rhamondre Stevenson scored 1.50 on the bench, so the empty slots cost him 1.50 points. Prepetente is the GOAT! trails Mean Machine 135.46 to 85.26 and only has Mark Andrews left.

Monday night is Chargers at Ravens. Players still to go: Zay Flowers (BertDirty), Mark Andrews (Marco_Polo), Derrick Henry (G8rDuc), Quentin Johnston (RobMeyers) and the Ravens defense (superdog91). None of them can change a result.

Bill_Buttlicker dropped Jaylen Wright on Sunday and didn't pick anybody up. Earlier in the week BertDirty dropped Dare Ogunbowale and TotesMagoat sold Kaleb Johnson and a 2029 3rd to BeatULikeABoss for a 2029 2nd.

stories.title: Picken Weiners drops 208.12 and wins by 141.46, and the commissioner is 7‑3 with a payout on the way
stories.dek: George Pickens scored 43.50, Ja'Marr Chase 36.10, Patrick Mahomes 37.42. Hanging with Hernandez is 2‑8 tonight, whatever Derrick Henry does.
body: I'll say it before anyone else does: Picken Weiners had the week. 208.12 points, the fourth-highest score of 2026, behind superdog91's 226.80 and 216.46 and TotesMagoat's 214.96. George Pickens scored 43.50, Patrick Mahomes scored 37.42 after a week of elbow questions, Ja'Marr Chase added 36.10, Stefon Diggs 20.30, Bhayshul Tuten 20.30 and Ryan Flournoy 19.10 at FLEX. Hanging with Hernandez put up 66.66 with Derrick Henry still to play tonight. If Henry gets a zero, that's a 141.46-point win, the biggest of the season. He's not getting a zero, so enjoy the asterisk.

Now the roast, because I owe it to you. I started Sam LaPorta at tight end and he scored 2.60. Harold Fannin Jr. scored 16.10 on my bench. Cam Ward (20.14), Jordyn Tyson (19.00) and Fannin gave Picken Weiners a 118.74-point bench, the most in the league this week. The bench payout was Week 9 and TotesMagoat already cashed it. I also dropped Jaylen Wright on Sunday and left the spot empty, which BertDirty will tell you is a whole movement now.

The rest of Sunday: Lemon Squeezy beat Hurts So Good 173.72 to 156.98 on Christian McCaffrey's 49.30 and Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 32.10, while Jahmyr Gibbs scored 45.20 for MakeItRains in a loss. That's 156.98, the highest losing score of the week, and Hurts So Good drops to 5{H}5. I Believe in Love upset Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 155.82 to 141.22. Trevor Have I Ever ended a three-game skid by beating Chubb So Big I Waddle 146.38 to 84.82 behind Chuba Hubbard's 34.20. 50 Shades of Rae beat Young Love Hunters 107.64 to 63.10, the lowest score of the week. Mean Machine leads Prepetente is the GOAT! by 50.20 with only Zay Flowers and Mark Andrews left.

Week 10's payout is Highest-Scoring Receiver, and Pickens's 43.50 leads. Monday's only starting receivers left are Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews and Quentin Johnston. One of them needs 43.60 or the commissioner pays himself for the second time in three weeks. If you're doing the playoff math, after tonight it's Lemon Squeezy, 50 Shades of Rae, Picken Weiners, Trevor Have I Ever, I Believe in Love and Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 in the top six, with Mean Machine and Hurts So Good at 5{H}5 behind on points.

stories.title: The Chiefs running back who beat ChuckJ10 wasn't Kenneth Walker III. It was Emmett Johnson, on Buccaneer51's roster
stories.dek: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 swapped out Walker in time and still lost by 14.60. I Believe in Love is 6‑4.
body: Credit where it's due: ChuckJ10 woke up and fixed it. Kenneth Walker III came out of the lineup, Breece Hall went in and scored 14.80. Dak Prescott threw for 35.42, Tony Pollard added 23.90, CeeDee Lamb 20.20 and Drake London 16.90. 141.22 is a normal winning score. It wasn't this week.

Buccaneer51 got 35.10 from Emmett Johnson at FLEX, a 23-year-old Chiefs running back on a week the Chiefs were without Walker. Cam Skattebo added 27.20 from Thursday, Jared Goff 22.42, the Vikings defense 22.00 and DJ Moore 20.40. I Believe in Love scored 155.82, its best score of the season, and that's 6{H}4 with the ninth-most points in the league.

Omar Cooper Jr. started at FLEX for ChuckJ10, got hurt (ankle) during the Bills game and was ruled out. He finished with 0.00. Not a bad call. Alvin Kamara had 16.40 on the bench, but nobody plays a guy who was expected to play and then gets hurt. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 falls to 5{H}5 with the third-most points in the league (1553.94 through Sunday) and holds the sixth seed on points. ChuckJ10 has gone 13{H}1 before without making a final. Going 5{H}5 and making it would be a new way to do it.

stories.title: Prepetente is the GOAT! played the whole week with no running backs, and it cost him 1.50 points
stories.dek: Marco_Polo's two empty RB slots were the story all weekend. The actual damage was Rhamondre Stevenson's 1.50. Mean Machine leads by 50.20.
body: We yelled about it Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday morning. The Munich game kicked off at 9:30 and both RB slots on Prepetente is the GOAT! were still empty. Rhamondre Stevenson, who was officially questionable and listed as expected to play, scored 1.50 on the bench. So the empty slots cost 1.50 points. The universe let Marco_Polo off easy and he should not read that as a strategy.

Brock Purdy scored 33.66 at quarterback, and Jayden Daniels's 20.76 sat on the bench, which was the right call. Xavier Hutchinson added 15.80 at FLEX. Mike Gesicki scored 1.90 at the other FLEX. Mark Andrews plays tonight and needs 50.20 more than Zay Flowers to steal it. Prepetente is the GOAT! is headed to 3{H}7.

BertDirty's Mean Machine got 35.16 from Joe Burrow, 24.40 from Nico Collins, 17.00 from the Rams defense and 16.10 from Quinshon Judkins, all with Josh Jacobs and Mike Evans out. That's four straight wins coming, 5{H}5, and 1367.96 points, the fourth-most. Mean Machine is a tiebreaker away from the playoff line.

stories.title: TotesMagoat sells Kaleb Johnson the week Josh Jacobs goes under the knife
stories.dek: Lemon Squeezy (8‑1) flips a bench back and a 2029 3rd for Young Love Hunters' 2029 2nd. It's the first league trade in almost two months.
body: The trade drought is over. TotesMagoat sent Kaleb Johnson and Lemon Squeezy's 2029 3rd to BeatULikeABoss for Young Love Hunters' 2029 2nd, and BeatULikeABoss got his own 2029 5th back in the deal. It's the first trade in this league since Sept. 17. Johnson is 23 and scored 23.20 points in nine weeks for Lemon Squeezy, every one of them on the bench, 12.80 of them in Week 9.

Here's why it's interesting: Josh Jacobs is getting surgery on a fractured ring finger, and the reports range from out indefinitely to a maximum of three weeks. Johnson ran 14 times for 68 yards and a touchdown against the Patriots once Jacobs went down. MarShawn Lloyd (Bill_Buttlicker, yes, me) is reported good to go for Sunday against the Vikings, so it's not a clean lead job. BeatULikeABoss didn't wait to find out. Johnson is already in Young Love Hunters' Week 10 lineup against 50 Shades of Rae, who is still a 99% favorite.

The dynasty math: TotesMagoat now owns 2029 2nds from himself and BeatULikeABoss, still has six firsts across the next three drafts, and the team that's 1-8 is the one most likely to make that 2nd an early one. He sold a guy who never cracked his lineup for a better pick in a year when Young Love Hunters could still be bad. BeatULikeABoss gets a 23-year-old back with a possible starting role for a few weeks and still holds eight 2027 picks in the first three rounds. Rich get richer, rebuild gets a running back. Nobody got robbed, which is honestly a disappointment for this website.

TotesMagoat wasn't done. He picked up David Njoku, who's on IR with a fibula injury but was designated to return on Nov. 4, and the Chargers defense. And I claimed Ashton Dulin and dropped Elijah Mitchell, because the Colts just traded Josh Downs and somebody has to catch passes in Indianapolis.

MakeItRains started Greg Dulcich at FLEX for 3.40 with Darren Waller (23.00) on the bench.

Puka Nacua had 35.00, Christian Watson 31.10, Bucky Irving 28.50 and Bijan Robinson 26.70. Josh Allen gave superdog91 12.86. G8rDuc left Bryce Young's 20.34 on the bench while J.J. McCarthy started for 7.28.

Lemon Squeezy 139.06, Picken Weiners 115.58. TotesMagoat is 8-1 and his bench (155.88, C.J. Stroud 37.36) takes the Week 9 payout. rumors.t: Bill_Buttlicker has reportedly asked the league office to review the Week 10 receiver payout 'for fairness,' then approved his own request, then paid himself in advance. ChuckJ10 has asked who reviews the reviewer. The reviewer said that's also Bill_Buttlicker.

Marco_Polo's two empty RB slots have reportedly hired an agent and are asking for a raise after scoring only 1.50 points less than Rhamondre Stevenson. The agent is also asking for Prepetente is the GOAT!'s 2028 1st. Marco_Polo said he'd think about it, which is how he handles everything.

trades.why: Puka Nacua is out at least a month and superdog91 is 7-2 and chasing a fourth title. Higgins (27) has 161.80 points. RobMeyers is 3-6 with one of the older cores in the league, and BeatULikeABoss's second could be the first pick of round two.
Josh Jacobs could miss up to three weeks. Warren (28) has 143.80 points and G8rDuc is 2-7 with no 2027 picks, so a pick for a 28-year-old running back is the right direction.
Jalen Hurts is on IR. Nix is 26 with 135.80 points and he's the third quarterback on a roster with Jared Goff and Matthew Stafford. Buccaneer51 gets a pick for the one he can't start.

Jake Ferguson is out multiple weeks and ChuckJ10 needs a tight end now. Kelce has 101.30 points and is 37. G8rDuc gets his own third back for a player who won't be on the next good Hanging with Hernandez team.
BeatULikeABoss already has Jordan Love and just paid $145 for Kyle McCord, and now sends the first that could be the 1.01 for a 38-year-old quarterback. In a dynasty league. On a 1-8 team.
Self-roast: Bill_Buttlicker's backup quarterback just became the Ravens' starter by accident, so naturally he sends a first for a second backup with zero career snaps. Fire me.
BertDirty sends a 22-year-old receiver with 138.30 points to the guy who already owns six firsts, for a 34-year-old with 81.10 points who just changed teams. The empire grows.

trying: 63.10, the lowest score of the week. Kyle McCord outscored the starting quarterback from the bench. BeatULikeABoss, you've got one win. Start the better quarterback.
Benched Bryce Young last week, he scored 20.34. Started Bryce Young this week, he scored 8.10 while J.J. McCarthy scored 18.12 on the bench. G8rDuc, flip a coin. It'd do better.
Four days of warnings and the RB slots stayed empty. It cost 1.50 points, which is luck, not a plan. Marco_Polo, it's Week 11. Put a running back in.

Best score of the year, 155.82, to knock off the third-highest scoring team in the league. Emmett Johnson 35.10 at FLEX. Buccaneer51 is 6-4. Good for you.

columns.dek: PICKENS! MAHOMES! CHASE! AND A TIGHT END WHO SCORED 2.60! I NEED TO LIE DOWN!
body: 208.12! Picken Weiners SCORED 208.12! GEORGE PICKENS 43.50! PATRICK MAHOMES 37.42! JA'MARR CHASE 36.10! THE COMMISSIONER IS WINNING BY 141.46 AND HE HAS ALREADY TEXTED ME FOUR TIMES ABOUT IT!

AND HE STARTED SAM LAPORTA! 2.60! HAROLD FANNIN JR. HAD 16.10 ON THE BENCH! 118.74 ON THE BENCH! THAT'S MORE THAN Young Love Hunters SCORED IN THE ACTUAL GAME! BY 55.64! I DID THE MATH! I DON'T EVEN LIKE MATH!
AND Marco_Polo! FOUR DAYS! I YELLED FOR FOUR DAYS! THE RB SLOTS STAYED EMPTY! AND IT COST 1.50 POINTS! ONE POINT FIVE! I LOST MY VOICE FOR ONE POINT FIVE! I WANT IT BACK!

AND Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 FIXED THE LINEUP! THEY DID THE RIGHT THING! AND THEY LOST TO A CHIEFS RUNNING BACK ANYWAY! EMMETT JOHNSON! 35.10! FOR I Believe in Love! FOOTBALL IS A CRUEL GAME AND I LOVE IT!

columns.title: ChuckJ10, you've got Pollard. Don't overthink the Walker call
columns.dek: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 is 5‑4 with a 79‑20 all-play record. Down 27.20 is nothing for this team.
body: Kenneth Walker III got added to the report Friday with a groin injury and didn't practice. That's the kind of thing that keeps you up. ChuckJ10, here's the deal: the Chiefs play at 1:00, so you get the inactive list before you have to lock anything. If he's active, he plays. If he isn't, you've got options. That's it. That's the whole film session.

You've got the third-most points in the league, 1412.72, and you're 5-4. You lose games because of the schedule, not your roster. Down 27.20 after Thursday with CeeDee Lamb, Drake London and Trey McBride still to play is nothing. Buccaneer51, enjoy the Skattebo lead tonight. It's Saturday. Saturday doesn't count.

columns.title: Holden McGroin's Four Rules After Thursday Night Football
columns.dek: One game is a sample size. I've built a whole system on it.
body: 1. Always start the quarterback who scored on Thursday. Jayden Daniels scored 20.76 on Marco_Polo's bench. Brock Purdy has scored 0.00 in Week 10. That's a 20.76-point lead for Daniels, and the math doesn't care that Purdy has 175.30 points this season and hasn't played yet.

2. Never start a quarterback whose team is about to win. G8rDuc benched J.J. McCarthy and the Giants lost 24-21 anyway. If McCarthy had been in the lineup the Giants would've known they had to try harder. That's called accountability.

3. Tight ends are wide receivers now. Isaiah Likely (28.70) is leading the Week 10 Highest-Scoring Receiver payout. Going forward I'm starting tight ends at quarterback. My first pick is Travis Kelce, who is 37 and has been throwing in the backyard for years, probably.
4. Empty roster spots are just players who haven't been named yet. Marco_Polo has two of them at running back this week. Think of the upside. Zero carries means zero fumbles. Every week. Undefeated.

columns.title: Picken Weiners' bench outscored two full lineups, which means the bench is a playoff team
columns.dek: 118.74 bench points, 63.10 for Young Love Hunters, 66.66 for Hanging with Hernandez. The model has some thoughts.
body: Let's start with the number nobody's talking about. Bill_Buttlicker's bench scored 118.74 in Week 10. Young Love Hunters' starters scored 63.10, and Hanging with Hernandez's scored 66.66. By my math, Picken Weiners' bench would be 2-0 this week. Over a full season that's a 14-0 bench, and benches don't get tired, so I'm projecting a title.

Next: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 has 1553.94 points and a 5-5 record. I Believe in Love has 1105.06 and is 6-4. That's 448.88 more points for one fewer win, or 448.88 points per anti-win. I've started calling it Points Above Winning, and ChuckJ10 leads the league in it every year. He went 13-1 last year, and I'm still counting that as a negative.

Christian McCaffrey scored 49.30 and Jahmyr Gibbs scored 45.20 in the same game, on opposite sides. That's 94.50 running back points in one matchup, and Hurts So Good lost by 16.74. So the running back who scored 4.10 more won. Running back points are worth about 4.10 points each. Please don't check that.

Finally, Marco_Polo's empty RB slots scored 0.00 and his benched RB scored 1.50. The gap is 1.50 points, or 1.76% of Prepetente is the GOAT!'s 85.26. In my model, that's statistically the same as starting a running back. I'm not saying the strategy works. I'm saying it's in the margin of error, and that's how I'd explain it to the league.

facts: TotesMagoat (4) and superdog91 (3) have won all seven titles since 2019. They've met in the final four times.
ChuckJ10 went 13-1 in 2025 and didn't make the final. TotesMagoat went 13-1 in 2023 and lost it. The best record has won it three times in seven years.
G8rDuc went 1-12 in 2020 and 1-13 in 2023. He's 22-83 all time and has never made the playoffs.
LAWRENCEndORDER (2022) and NixInTheStix (2023) both named their team "Wilson is a flop" and both went home after one season.
Bill_Buttlicker's 224.90 in 2024 Week 14 is the third-highest score in league history. The team was called Fire Sale.

th.note: Every trade in Sleeper history, 2019 through 2025, graded by what each side actually got. Value = PPR fantasy points each player scored from the day of the trade through Week 8 of 2026. Picks count the player who was actually drafted with that pick, from his rookie year on. It measures production, not trade value today: a 2025 rookie hasn't had time to catch up to a five-year vet.
th.ledgerNote: Graded trades only. Net = points received minus points sent, added up across every trade. Former managers in italics.

top.t: The Trade That Built an Empire
top.take: In January 2020, superdog91 sent the picks that became Justin Jefferson and Justin Herbert to TotesMagoat for Devin Singletary and a third. Jefferson and Herbert have scored 3,708.3 points since. TotesMagoat has four titles. superdog91 has three, which is impressive given he handed his rival the keys.

Bill_Buttlicker got Patrick Mahomes and the pick that became Chuba Hubbard. G8rDuc got Drew Brees, who retired after the season, and the Michael Carter pick. The scoreboard says 2,853.1 to 529.9. G8rDuc is 22-80 all time, and this is part of why.

ChuckJ10 bought Michael Thomas in November 2020 and paid with Christian Kirk plus his 2021 and 2022 firsts. Thomas gave him 220.1 points. The 2022 first became Chris Olave. ChuckJ10 has never made a final, and trades like this are a big reason why.

superdog91 got Kenny Gainwell and the picks that became George Pickens (#16) and Kyren Williams, a fourth-rounder at #40, all for Devin Singletary. Kyren alone has 970.9 points. RedDevil904 still has never made the playoffs.

RedDevil904 sent five picks to Bill_Buttlicker for Christian McCaffrey. Those picks became Javonte Williams, Elijah Moore, Kenneth Walker III, Malik Willis and Roschon Johnson. CMC gave RedDevil904 1,482.6 points. The picks have given 2,855.7.

TotesMagoat got Amon-Ra St. Brown from Besch42 for Mecole Hardman Jr. and Quintez Cephus. St. Brown has 1,598.9 points since. Four months later, Besch42 lost the 2021 final to TotesMagoat. He'd handed him the WR1 himself.

Self-roast time. Bill_Buttlicker traded the picks that became DeVonta Smith (#11) and Kenny Gainwell to RedDevil904 for Miles Sanders. Sanders: 524.5. Smith and Gainwell: 1,782.6. The man who runs this website did that.

top.t: Pollard for a Pick That Missed
top.take: superdog91 sent Tony Pollard to ChuckJ10 for a 2021 second that became Terrace Marshall. Pollard has 1,255.7 points since. Marshall has 155.8.
